The vehicle with VIN KM8JECA14NU014932 represents everything modern drivers want in a midsize SUVstyle, technology, comfort, safety, and versatilitywrapped into one refined package that feels just as at home pulling into a luxury hotel valet as it does loading up for a weekend road trip. This Hyundai Tucson stands out immediately with its bold, sculpted design that Hyundai introduced with this generation. The angular body lines, wide stance, and distinctive front grille give the Tucson a confident road presence that looks far more premium than many vehicles in its class. Hyundais signature Parametric Hidden Lights are seamlessly integrated into the grille, creating a striking look during the day and an unmistakable lighting signature at night. Its a design that doesnt just blend into trafficit turns heads.

Step inside and you immediately understand why the Tucson became one of the most talked-about SUVs in its segment. The interior feels modern, clean, and thoughtfully designed with high-quality materials and an open, spacious layout that makes both driver and passengers feel comfortable and connected. The dashboard is dominated by a sleek touchscreen infotainment system that integrates seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to access navigation, music, calls, and apps effortlessly. The digital interface is intuitive and responsive, making every interaction smooth whether youre selecting a playlist or checking directions on the fly.

Comfort is one of the Tucsons biggest strengths, and this VIN delivers in every way. The seats are supportive and ergonomically designed for long drives, with plenty of legroom and headroom for both front and rear passengers. Whether youre commuting across town or taking a multi-hour highway trip, everyone in the vehicle rides in comfort. Rear passengers enjoy generous space and excellent visibility, while the wide rear doors make entry and exit easy for adults, kids, and even loading child seats.

Cargo capacity is another area where the Tucson shines. Behind the rear seats youll find plenty of room for groceries, sports gear, luggage, or whatever life throws your way. Fold the rear seats down and the space expands dramatically, transforming the Tucson into a capable hauler ready for road trips, moving days, or weekend adventures. Hyundai designed the cargo area with practicality in mind, offering a low load floor and wide opening so loading bulky items is simple.

Under the hood, the Tucson balances performance and efficiency beautifully. Its powertrain delivers smooth acceleration and confident highway performance while maintaining excellent fuel economy for an SUV of this size. Whether you're merging onto the interstate, navigating city traffic, or cruising down an open highway, the Tucson feels composed, responsive, and refined. Hyundai engineered this platform to provide a comfortable ride without sacrificing control, so bumps are absorbed smoothly while the steering remains precise and confidence-inspiring.

Safety and Security

Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

    • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Driver Attention Alert - Snap To it. Sometimes the drive is boring, sometimes you're tired, sometimes your mind starts to drift. Driver attention alert uses sensors to monitor the vehicle and/or driver's behavior and will flash or sound a warning to help keep you focused on the road ahead. Driver Attention Alert helps ensure your car doesn't drift when you do.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Additionally, the **Mobile Hotspot** feature ensures that you can enjoy internet access no matter where your travels take you. This is perfect for streaming music, checking emails, or browsing the web without using up your mobile data.
